resources.string: Pairing is optional. Connect to receive contract settings and Tasks from your Dom after reviewing what you share.
Your Dom creates an invitation. Open or paste its code on this Sub device, compare the device fingerprint, and approve. Your Dom must also approve before pairing completes.
Your Dom manages contract settings and artwork, sees app names, configured app usage, statistics, Activity, and device and session state, and can end the active session.
Use Connection → Unpair with keyholder authorization. Revocation stops future sharing once received; it does not erase information already shared.
Read the instructions and deadline in Tasks. Send a completion request when the work is ready.
Choose Request completion, add text or up to five attachments, then send. Proof belongs to your completion request.
Your request stays Pending review until your Dom accepts or denies it. Request review outside the app sends a request without in-app proof; acceptance is still required.
Preview box, pixelation, blur, or static for this device.
Choose optional tribute events, prices, correction time, and daily and weekly caps. Rules do not authorize payment; saved-wallet auto-pay requires separate consent.
Choose which installed apps use your contract. Daily allowances are configured in Limits. A paired Dom manages these settings.
Settings → Allowed features lets you disable Censor, Limits, Tributes, Whispers, and Popup Storm locally.
Disabled features cannot run or accept changes from your Dom, including queued updates. Hardcore overrides these choices only after you enable it locally.
For stronger protection against quitting, you can opt in locally in Settings. Hardcore is optional; review its effects and your recovery access first.
Accessibility and Device Admin help guard supported uninstall and data-clear controls in Sub mode. Hardcore does not start protection by itself.
With your local consent, Hardcore overrides Allowed features. Turning it off in Settings releases the guard and restores your choices. Android also permits Device Admin deactivation.
Saved-wallet auto-pay needs separate consent, a verified linked wallet, and an active service lock. If already enabled, it can send eligible tribute while Hardcore is on, within your caps.

A local keyholder PIN is optional when unpaired. When paired, your Dom provides a keyholder code for local recovery and unpairing; ordinary contract changes stay with your Dom. Check this access before enabling Hardcore.
